questions.question:
**Select the correct active voice of the given sentence.**

All the clients are being informed by the Bank Manager through an SMS about the change in bank timings.

options.text: The Bank Manager informs all the clients through SMS about the change in bank timings.
The Bank Manager had informed all the clients through SMS about the change in bank timings.
The Bank Manager is informing all the clients through SMS about the change in bank timings.
The Bank Manager has informed all the clients through SMS about the change in bank timings.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'The Bank Manager is informing all the clients through SMS about the change in bank timings'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the Passive Voice. As per the given question we have to change the sentence into Active Form. 
 
• The given sentence is an example of 'present continuous'. 
 
• The structure of these kinds of sentences is:
 
 
• Subject + is/am/are + V1+ing + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject(Objective Case)+ is/am/are + being + V3+ by + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice) 
 
 
• *Example:*
 
 
• *He is riding a bike.*
 
• *A bike is being ridden by him. *
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• Here, in the given question **'are being informed'** will be changed into **'is informing'. **
 
• **'By' **will be removed.
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is **Option 3.** 

**Correct Sentence:__** *The Bank Manager is informing all the clients through SMS about the change in bank timings.*​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The transformation of imperative sentences: 
 
• If someone gives a command, do request, express a desire or wish, in sentences then such sentences are called an imperative sentence. 
 
• If the notion of a sentence is 'Command' then structure: 
 
 
• V1 + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Let + subject + be + V3. (Passive Voice)
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *Teach your students. (Active Voice)*
 
• *Let your students be taught. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
 
 
• If the notion of a sentence is that of an 'Order', then structure: 
 
 
• V1 + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• You are ordered + V 1+ Object. (Passive Voice)
 
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *Drive the car. (Active Voice)*
 
• *You are ordered to drive the car. (Passive Voice) *

questions.question:
**Select the correct active form of the given sentence.**

An elderly lady was knocked down by a speeding car this morning.

options.text: A speeding car was knocking down an elderly lady this morning.
A speeding car knocks down an elderly lady this morning.
A speeding car knocked down an elderly lady this morning.
A speeding car had knocked down an elderly lady this morning.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is- 'A speeding car knocked down an elderly lady this morning.' 

***__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in the past indefinite tense.

 
 
• So the structure for conversion is

 
 
• *subject + verb (3rd form) + object*
 
• Example: 
 
 
• An umbrella was brought by Rohan from the market. *(**passive**)
 
• *Rohan brought an umbrella from the market. *(**active**)
 
 
 
 
 
 

Thus *option 3 *is the correct answer. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ *​​​***

 
• Let's understand how the sentence structure changes in the past tense while converting from active to passive voice:

 
 
• Simple past- *subject + was/were + verb (3rd form) + object*

 
 
• *​*Example: *Football was played by him.*
 
 
 
• Past continuous - *subject + was/were + being + verb (3rd form) + object*
 
 
• *​*Example: *The car was being driven by him.*
 
 
 
• Past perfect - *subject + had + been + verb (3rd form) + object*
 
 
• *​*Example: *The car had been driven by him.*

questions.question:
**Direction: Select the correct active form of the given sentence.**

A statement had already been issued to the press on the lockdown by the authorities.

options.text: The authorities had already issued a statement to the press on the lockdown.
The authorities have already issued a statement to the press on the lockdown.
A statement had already issued the authorities to the press on the lockdown.
The authorities are already issuing a statement to the press on the lockdown.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'****The authorities had already issued a statement to the press on the lockdown.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Past Perfect Tense and **Passive** Voice.
 
• The rule for changing a Past Perfect Tense from** Passive voice to Active voice**:
 
 
• Interchange the object and subject with each other, i.e. object of the active sentence become the subject of the passive sentence.​
 
• Structure__: Subject + had + past participle (V3) + object __(Active Voice)__

 Object + had + been + past participle (V3) + (by + subject) __(Passive Voice)__ 
 __
 
• Example: *Disha had arranged the things. *(Active Voice)

 * The things had been arranged by Disha.** *(Passive Voice)
 
 
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is 'The authorities had already issued a statement to the press on the lockdown.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• In Active Voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject performing an action.
 
• In Passive Voice, the sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
 
 
• Example: *He reads a novel. *(Active Voice)

 * A novel is read by him. *(Passive Voice)*​*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

__
 
• दिया गया वाक्य Past Perfect Tense और Passive Voice में है।
 
• Past Perfect Tense को **Passive Voice से Active voice** में बदलने का नियम:
 
 
• Object और Subject को एक दूसरे के साथ बदलें, यानी Active Voice का Object, Passive Voice का Subject बन जाता है।
 
• संरचना__: Subject + had + past participle (V3) + object __(Active Voice)__

 Object + had + been + past participle (V3) + (by + subject) __(Passive Voice)__ 
 
 
• Example: *Disha had arranged the things. *(Active Voice)

 * The things had been arranged by Disha.** *(Passive Voice)

**Directions: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

Enough money will have been saved by me for a new house by next year

options.text: I will be saving enough money for a new house by next year.
I will save enough money for a new house by next year.
I will have saved enough money for a new house by next year.
I will have been saving enough money for a new house by next year.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**I will have saved enough money for a new house by next year**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In Active Voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject, performing an action.
 
• In Passive Voice, a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
 
• The given sentence is in the passive voice and it is in the present perfect tense.
 
• When we convert this sentence into an active voice, the subject 'Enough money' of the passive voice becomes the object, and the object 'me' becomes the subject 'I'.
 
• The passive format "have + been + V3 (saved)" should be converted into the active format "**have + **V3** (saved)**".
 
• This is the active and passive voice rule for the present perfect tense.

questions.question:
**Select the correct active voice of the given sentence.**

A standing ovation was received by the storytellers who participated in the International Festival.

options.text: In the International Festival the participating storytellers were receiving a standing ovation.
The storytellers who participated in the International Festival received a standing ovation.
The storytellers who participated in the International Festival will be receiving a standing ovation.
The storytellers who participated in the International Festival had been receiving a standing ovation.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **The storytellers who participated in the International Festival received a standing ovation.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in the passive form and in the Simple past tense and we need to change it to the **active **form.
 
• The Simple past in the passive voice has the following form: Subject + was/were + past participle + by object__
 
• The Simple past in the active voice has the following form: __Subject + past participle + object__
 __
 
• Passive: *A letter was written by him.*
 
• Active: *He wrote a letter.*
 
 
 
• ​Therefore, the correct answer is option 2.

 

Correct Active Voice:__ *The storytellers who participated in the International Festival received a standing ovation.*

questions.question:
**Select the correct active voice of the given sentence.**

Are the rules and regulations being followed by the Sports Authority in the selection procedure for the Olympics?

options.text: Has the Sports Authority been following rules and regulations in the selection procedure for the Olympics?
Was the Sports Authority following rules and regulations in the selection procedure for the Olympics?
Is the Sports Authority following rules and regulations in the selection procedure for the Olympics?
Had the Sports Authority been following rules and regulations in the selection procedure for the Olympics?

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Is the Sports Authority following rules and regulations in the selection procedure for the Olympics?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in the passive form and in the present continuous tense in interrogative form and we need to change it into the active form.
 
• The present continuous in the passive voice has the following form:** Is/am/are + Object+ V3+ by subject +?__**
 
• The present continuous in the active voice has the following form: __**Is/am/are+ subject + v1 + ing + object+?**__

 __
 
• Passive: *Is a table being bought by Ritika?*
 
• Active: *Is Ritika buying a table?*
 
 
 
• In the active voice of the present continuous, we have to change the structure, so the subject in the passive voice becomes the object in the active voice.

​Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.

Correct Active Voice:__ *Is the Sports Authority following rules and regulations in the selection procedure for the Olympics?*

questions.question:
**Select the correct active voice of the given sentence.**

Online summer camps in different sports have been arranged for students by the education ministry.

options.text: By the education ministry in different sports online summer camps have been arranged for students.
The education ministry is arranging online summer camps in different sports for students.
The education ministry has arranged online summer camps in different sports for students.
Online summer camps in different sports are going to be arranged by the education ministry for students

questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**The education ministry has arranged online summer camps in different sports for students.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• There are few things to remember when changing a sentence from **passive **to **active **voice.

 
 
• The **object **in the passive voice becomes the **subject **of the active voice.
 
• In the given sentence, "**the education ministry**" is the subject of the active voice.
 
• The **subject **in the passive voice becomes the **object **of the active voice.
 
• In the given sentence, "**o****nline summer camps**" becomes the object of the active.
 
• The given sentence is in the **present perfect tense** so "**been**" is used after the auxiliary verb "**have**". 
 
• The structure of the passive voice sentence is : **Object +auxiliary verb+ been+ V₃+subject.**
 
• In the given sentence the **auxiliary **verb "**have**" and the past participle of "**be**" which is "**been**" in used in the passive voice.
 
• The structure of the active voice sentence is : **subject +auxiliary verb+ verb +object.**
 
• The usage of **past participle** of "be" which is "been" is omitted in the active voice.
 
• In the given sentence, **auxiliary **verb "**has**" should be used in the active voice of the sentence.
 
 

​Hence, the correct answer is **option 3**.

questions.question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

The booking will have been closed when you reach the theatre.

options.text: They would have closed the booking when you reach the theatre.
They had closed the booking when you reached the theatre.
They will have closed the booking when you reach the theatre.
They will close the booking when you reach the theatre.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'They will have closed the booking when you reach the theatre.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is an example of Passive Voice. As per the given question we have to change it into Active Voice. 
 
• The process of transformation is as follows:
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'The booking'.
 
• The object of the given sentence is 'they (hidden)'.
 
• Since modal verb has been used in the passive voice, therefore, the active voice will follow the given structure:
 
 
• Passive Voice - modal verb*(will)* + have + been + V3
 
• Active Voice - modal verb*(will) *+ have + V3
 
 
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject. 
 
• 'will have been closed' will be changed into 'will have closed'.

 
 
 

Correct Sentence:__* They will have closed the booking when you reach the theatre.*

You are requested to leave your phones at the reception.

options.text: Please requesting leave your phones at the reception.
Please leave your phones at the reception.
Please left your phones at the reception.
Please leaving your phones at the reception.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**Please leave your phones at the reception​****​**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In Active Voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject, performing an action.
 
• In Passive Voice, a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
 
• The given passive voice is **an imperative sentence containing a request**.
 
• The imperative sentences are the sentences in which we **express our feelings and emotions like **request,** order, advice and **command.
 
• The **passive voice** of sentences **containing** '**request**' start with ‘**You are requested to**’.
 
• Generally, the **active voice** sentences containing '**request**' have the word ‘**please**’ in it and the **verb remains in the same form**.
 
• Therefore, the phrase 'You are requested to' in the passive voice is **replaced by** '**please**' in the active voice.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.
